recognize_zh: 中倍骨髓切片細胞密度高，骨小樑旁有密集成片、核大淡染的未成熟骨髓系前驅細胞，間有散在嗜酸性球；此倍率只能提示左移的顆粒球生成，無法單獨確診。
features: Dense band of immature myeloid precursors with oval vesicular nuclei adjacent to a trabecula
Scattered eosinophils with red granules and erythroid islands
Mature neutrophils difficult to assess at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at intermediate power shows a hypercellular marrow with reduced fat. A dense, expanded zone of immature myeloid precursors with oval vesicular nuclei lies adjacent to a bony trabecula, with scattered eosinophils, erythroid islands and edematous hemorrhagic areas elsewhere. The proportion of mature neutrophils cannot be reliably assessed at this magnification. Findings suggest a left-shifted granulopoiesis compatible with severe congenital neutropenia, requiring aspirate differential for confirmation.

ddx.vs: AML shows diffuse effacement by blasts with CD34/CD117 positivity and a blast count of at least 20 percent on aspirate.
Reactive hyperplasia shows orderly maturation with abundant bands and segmented neutrophils.
Tumor forms cohesive nests with desmoplasia and is negative for myeloid markers.
